name: Unsent's toolbox NF Ver
description:
Version : 2.0
This developer toolbox designed for NovaFlare Engine 1.2.x.
Developer Tools:
C - Toggle Botplay  Shift + C - Toggle Fake Botplay
V - Toggle Practice Mode  N/M - Adjust Scroll Speed
Ctrl + N/M - Adjust Playback Rate  P - Toggle Developer Output
Ctrl + R - Reset Playback Rate  Shift + R - Reset Scroll Speed
Alt + R - Reset Health to 50%  Alt + N/M - Adjust Health
Space + H/G - Soft Pause  Space - Exit Soft Pause

Reset Property requires NovaFlare Engine's No Reset option to be enabled.
